description: What lenders reported for a U.S. county in the latest HMDA filing year: purchase, refinance and cash-out loans and applications by loan type (conventional, FHA, VA, USDA) against the national mix, and the denial rate with its base named. Describes a market, never a person; small counts are withheld. Give a county FIPS code, or a county name with its state.

county.description: county name, e.g. "Bexar" or "Los Angeles County"; give state too

county_fips.description: 5-digit county FIPS code, e.g. "48029" for Bexar County, TX

state.description: two-letter state code, needed with county

year.description: optional HMDA filing year; defaults to the latest published

name: county_lending_market
title: Mortgage lending in a county (HMDA)
